title: I just heard of this sub, and I’m a little freaked out now
content: There is a dream world I visit most often and I have come to know it as The Hotel. But it’s not just a hotel, it’s like the biggest building you’ve ever seen and it’s layed out like a mall on the inside. It’s maybe 20 stories high and contains countless shops, restaurants, etc. Even office administration which I’ve been to. It’s also got hotel like areas and some pools, it has normal living quarters, communal restrooms that for some reason aren’t well kept. There are arcades also, and it’s home to what I call The Theatre. Which as you might have guessed, is theatre. But like a weird one because I feel like that’s a central hub point of something. Everyone gathers there for something important. There are sets of elevators in the corners or the mega building and large escalators in the middle. Kinda freaked out when I saw someone mention this sub. This is where I have my most real dreams, and where I have lucid dreamed a lot. There are places around the mega building but I think they are kinda like homeless/poor housing because I remember being on my toes like worried I was going to get jumped in that area.
